messages:
ellie: Heads-up — since the EU edge swap at 10:00 UTC we're seeing a handful of SNI handshake failures to downstream-apigw in apac. Errors surfaced in edge-metrics: `tls_handshake_failures++` :warning:

sam: logs?

ellie: Pasting sample from nginx-proxy logs (EU edge node 3):
```
TLSv1.3 alert decrypt_error
Client hello SNI "downstream-apigw" (ip 3.72.12.45)
Selected cert chain didn't match SNI
```

kevin: Any KMS decrypt errors?

nora: Yes, rotator logs show KMS Unwrap failures for apac-keystore key-id `proj/apac/rot-2` around same time. `403 AccessDenied` from KMS for the service account. audit-bot recorded an IAM policy change 9m before deploy: role "keystore-operator" had binding removed.

pj: That sounds like RBAC rollback during a terraform change. Who applied?

ellie: @kevin was on rollouts yesterday, but the terraform run was by infra-bot (CI). @sam can you check the commit?

sam: found pipeline #4883 — applied `roles/keystore-operator` removal in apac. It was intended for deprecated app. Oops.

kevin: Confirmed — I reverted the binding via console. KMS unwraps resumed but some nodes still serving old certs.

nora: We still see `Selected cert chain didn't match SNI` — I suspect the keystore rotation partially completed: intermediates missing in bundle. The edge caches certs for 5m TTL.

ellie: Do we have an immediate mitigation? Canary rollback? Force refresh?

pj: Suggestion:
- Re-add RBAC binding (done)
- Restart rotator in apac region (rolling) to re-publish full chain
- Force keystore refresh on EU edge nodes with `curl -XPOST https://edge.example.com/_admin/keystore/refresh`
- Monitor handshake rate

sam: I'm restarting rotator now (jobs 7721). Also nuking the edge cache on the two affected nodes.

infra-bot: Deploy job 7721 started by sam — rolling 3 pods in apac-rotator.

audit-bot: IAM policy change detected: role keystore-operator re-added by kevin. EventID: ev_2026_03_21_1776543200

nora: After restart, KMS unwrap success logs:
```
unwrap: key=proj/apac/rot-2 result=ok
cert_bundle_size=3
```

ellie: Great. Handshakes dropped back to baseline after ~90s. Still want follow-up actions.

kevin: Postmortem checklist:
- Add pipeline guard to prevent removal of keystore roles without explicit ack
- Add canary gating for RBAC terraform plans
- Alerting: add KMS unwrap 5xx rate alert tied to rotator (pager)
- Audit log retention: ensure keystore binding events keep 90d retention

pj: Also run a global cert-bundle verification script weekly across regions:
`for r in eu apac us; do curl https://edge.$r.example.com/_admin/keystore/verify; done`
If missing intermediates, auto-alert on slack channel #eng-security.

ellie: I'll open a short incident doc and owner tags. Also recommend tightening TLS config: require full chain verification on ingress and warn on partial bundles.

sam: Filing incident: https://incidents/1776543210 (link)

nora: Anything else? We should rotate the impacted intermediate cert with CA because TTL left is short (7 days).

kevin: I'll coordinate with CA team. ETA 36h for new intermediate issuance. For now, we validated fallback policies worked and no customer data was exposed.

ellie: Thanks everyone. Closing once CA rotation scheduled and terraform pipeline patched. :thumbsup:
